Forecast architecture

Weather data

Open-Meteo

Hourly irradiance, temperature and cloud cover

Cloud Run container

FastAPI forecast service

  1. Align weather to the 164-cell Canada grid.
  2. Estimate hourly power with the bundled XGBoost model.
  3. Sum the hourly estimates to get 24-hour energy.

Browser

Canada dashboard

Energy map and hourly power chart

The browser reads the forecast from GET /forecast/canada.

FastAPI aligns cells to a common UTC window and computes local calendar features before calling XGBoost. The browser requests /forecast/canada. A separate daily prediction API uses a model in Cloud Storage.

Sources: hourly forecast service and FastAPI routes.

How changes reach Cloud Run

GitHub Actions builds the UI, API and hourly model into one Docker image.

  1. Build & test

    Check the frontend and run a container smoke test.

  2. Publish

    Push the tested image to Artifact Registry.

  3. Verify

    Check the candidate revision against live weather.

  4. Route traffic

    Send public traffic to the verified revision.

Branch pushes and pull requests run the build and test. A push to main runs the full release.

On main, GitHub Actions uses Workload Identity Federation to sign in to Google Cloud with short-lived credentials. It publishes the tested image by commit SHA and deploys it by digest.

Sources: workflow and deployment script.

Two tests, different weather inputs

In GitHub Actions

Fixed weather

Run the container without network access and check model startup and forecast output for all 164 cells.

On the Cloud Run candidate

Live weather

Check that the candidate can fetch weather and return a fresh forecast with 24 hourly values and consistent energy totals.

Both checks verify that the dashboard and model serve valid responses.

The fixture test requires full coverage. The live test permits partial weather coverage and checks the time window, energy sum and highest-cell ranking for the available forecasts.

Sources: container check and forecast smoke test.

The candidate’s tagged URL is accessible to the test while it receives no regular service traffic. If the check fails, the script stops before routing traffic. The first deployment from main passed the build, live check and traffic switch.

Sources: first deployment run and deployment script.

Validating the forecast

Forecast accuracy across Canada is still unvalidated.

Forecast inputs
Use archived weather forecasts to measure how forecast errors affect output estimates.
Cold-weather performance
Compare estimates with measured solar generation at Canadian sites, including during cold periods.

The hourly model uses observed weather for training. The serving code flags forecasts when daylight temperatures fall outside the training range.
